_comment: Design brief for scripts/gen-pet.js. Edit freely; every field is dropped into the prompt skeletons in .claude/skills/pet-as-character/SKILL.md.

directions.label: cat
directions.rationale: keeps the cat the product already promises in its README and tray icon
directions.subject: baby cat with a round head and two small rounded ears
directions.feature: one thick rounded tail curled beside the feet
directions.colors: warm apricot orange body with a cream belly and muzzle, plus a soft pink accent on the inner ears and nose
directions.expression: calm, awake and friendly, eyes wide open, faint closed smile

directions.label: squirrel
directions.rationale: stashes everything it finds - the app's whole promise in one silhouette
directions.subject: baby squirrel with round cheeks full of what it has stashed
directions.feature: one enormous soft rounded tail arcing up behind the body, as wide as the body itself
directions.colors: warm chestnut brown body with a cream chest and tail tip, plus a soft peach accent on the cheeks
directions.expression: cheeks puffed a little, eyes wide open and pleased, tiny closed mouth

directions.label: owl
directions.rationale: watches and hears everything while you work, then reports back in the morning
directions.subject: baby owl standing upright with a rounded body and two small rounded ear tufts
directions.feature: one pair of short rounded wings folded flat against the sides
directions.colors: warm mustard ochre body with a cream face disc and chest, plus a soft coral accent on the beak and feet
directions.expression: large calm attentive eyes, small blunt rounded beak, quietly alert

frames.pose: standing calmly upright, both eyes open and round, a faint friendly closed smile, arms relaxed at the sides - the neutral resting pose
exactly the resting pose, unchanged in every way, except both eyes are closed as two soft downward arcs
eyes wide, round and surprised, mouth open in a small o, body upright and alert, both arms slightly raised
head tilted a little to one side, eyes looking up and away in thought, one front paw raised to touch the cheek
ears perked high and forward, head tilted toward a sound, mouth slightly open, leaning in attentively
both eyes closed as two upward happy arcs, wide open smile, body leaning back in a small delighted hop with both arms up
ears and shoulders drooping, eyes looking down, mouth a small flat line, arms hanging low
sitting down curled and completely relaxed, eyes closed as two soft arcs, head tipped to one side, tail wrapped around the feet
